name: notion-convert-page-to-skill
description:
Mark an existing Notion page as a skill without changing its content. The page must be in the current workspace, and the authenticated user must have permission to edit it. Use this tool only when the user wants the page's current contents designated as a skill.

If availability is not already known for this connection, call get_tool_access with {} before using this tool. Reuse the returned access map across tools; check the status and restricted_parameters.

page_url.description: The full Notion URL of the page to mark as a skill.
